defects.title: Published artifacts are not traceable to the v0.1.0 release identity
defects.observed: CLI, VSIX, Web package, MCP server, SBOM, scanner reports and the DevEco embedded runtime identify as 0.0.0; the tag and DevEco plugin descriptor say 0.1.0. arkcompat --version printed usage and exited 1.
defects.reproduction: Run the published CLI --version or inspect package.json/SBOM/VSIX/server metadata; scan any project and read scannerVersion.
defects.rootCause: No shared release-version constant; workspace versions and scannerVersion stayed at 0.0.0 while the tag was created as v0.1.0.
defects.fix: Added ARKCOMPAT_VERSION=0.1.0 in @arkcompat/contracts; bumped all workspace/app versions; added --version/-v/version; wired scanner, assessment, MCP server, SBOM and VSIX.
defects.verification: Fixed CLI/SBOM/VSIX/DevEco embedded runtime/scanner report/MCP all report 0.1.0; CLI version exit 0.
defects.residual: Published v0.1.0 assets remain 0.0.0 because release assets must not be modified; a new release is required.

defects.title: Published Web artifact cannot start outside the workspace
defects.reproduction: Extract arkcompat-web.tar.gz into an empty directory and run the packaged server with Node.
defects.rootCause: The server entry imported the workspace package by bare specifier; no production node_modules was packaged.
defects.fix: Build dist/server.bundle.mjs with esbuild, copy it as server.mjs, copy knowledge.schema.json, add bundled-consumer schema fallback and a package-level test.
defects.verification: Rebuilt standalone artifact serves / and /api/knowledge/status; web-package test passes.
defects.residual: Published web asset remains broken; new release required.

defects.title: Release archives were not byte-reproducible
defects.observed: Two clean builds produced different bytes for CLI, Web and VSIX despite identical content; source tar was generated from a dirty worktree.
defects.reproduction: Run package:release twice into separate directories and compare SHA-256.
defects.rootCause: Tar/gzip recorded mtimes and filesystem order; vsce emitted ZIP entries in filesystem order with generated timestamps; packaging allowed a dirty worktree.
defects.fix: Deterministic tar (sorted entries, fixed mtimes/ownership, gzip -n -9), sorted ZIP rewrite with fixed DOS timestamps, clean-worktree guard.
defects.verification: rebuild9 and rebuild10 identical for 8/8 artifacts; source tar equals git archive HEAD.
defects.residual: Determinism is verified on this macOS/Node/pnpm/tar/gzip toolchain only; cross-OS reproduction remains untested.

defects.title: Fixed Web viewer rejected reports from the published release
defects.observed: After the version bump, the schema const 0.1.0 rejected the published release's 0.0.0 reports although schemaVersion was still 0.12.0.
defects.reproduction: Import a canonical 0.12.0 report with scannerVersion 0.0.0 into the fixed Web viewer.
defects.rootCause: scannerVersion was modeled as a release constant rather than a producer semver string.
defects.fix: Schema pattern accepts any x.y.z; TS type is string; acceptance test added for a different release; non-semver still rejected.
defects.verification: Browser import rendered 10 rows for both 0.0.0 and 0.1.0 reports; 'latest' rejected.
defects.residual: Cross-release compatibility is limited to the same report schemaVersion; historical schema migrations remain rejected.

releaseMetadataDefects.title: Release body calls the DevEco plugin an official Huawei plugin
releaseMetadataDefects.observed: The release body says 华为官方 DevEco Studio IDE 插件; the repository states this is an independent community project, not official or certified by Huawei.
releaseMetadataDefects.action: Correct the wording in the next release; do not edit the published release without owner approval.

releaseMetadataDefects.title: Release body overstates third-party notices coverage
releaseMetadataDefects.observed: The body says THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.json contains 243 dependencies; the file inventories 12 production runtime packages and says file-inventory-only.
releaseMetadataDefects.action: Clarify runtime-notice scope versus the 243-dependency audit in the next release.

releaseMetadataDefects.title: Release body omits the external Node prerequisite
releaseMetadataDefects.observed: CLI and VSIX contain no Node executable and require an operator-provided Node 22.13+/24; the body describes the CLI as 内嵌运行时.
releaseMetadataDefects.action: Document the Node prerequisite explicitly in the next release and README.
